name: font_manager_add_path

provenance.source: Exact .155 AP-backed IDA function with font_manager_add_path name/source strings and resolver call; raw function chunk independently rehashed against the pinned AP.

notes: Resolves the current family path through 0x0c490edc; returns zero if it already matches. Otherwise appends a registry node through 0x0c3a46a2 and allocates/copies both strings. Lookup takes the first matching name: remove the old entry before adding a replacement. UI owner thread only, never under interrupt lock. Affects subsequently created font wrappers, not existing ones. Device probe pending.
